LESSON: PLANE FIGURES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.3: Plane Figures
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Plane Figures, part of Geometry in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: how 1. How can you identify shapes from objects? 2. How can you make patterns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Plane Figures together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: The learner develops relationship skills when discussing lines of symmetry in each plane shape.

● Creativity and imagination: The learners develop their mental image when making patterns using squares, rectangles

and triangles.

Values:
• Unity: The learner works together with others when discussing together to recognize shapes of rectangles, squares,

triangles, circles and ovals from common objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security: The learner safely sketches, manipulates and explores the shapes of rectangles, squares, triangles

circles and ovals from objects.
